scientific_integrity: Direct algebraic derivations plus Kummer theory and Chebotarev, corroborated by 105 finite field cases; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to n>=3 with 2^n-1 prime, and odd-prime reductions.
Automorphism group classifications are rational-point statements; the group scheme at p=2^n-1 is nonreduced.
First two density/automorphism ingredients generalize established monomial/diagonal results; Kummer and Chebotarev are classical.
Does not resolve arbitrary rational evolution algebra reductions or certify absolute historical priority.
title: Three prime-specialization strata for Mersenne-cycle evolution algebras
